csv_project_name: AE for Public Works Building Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Upland is seeking proposals from qualified companies to provide professional design and engineering services for the renovation of the existing Public Works Building. The purpose of this Project is to renovate the existing building to modernize and upgrade the existing layout and finishes to accommodate additional personnel. The building renovation will require analyzing existing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems to determine if upsizing is required, installation of new exterior doors and patching of redundant entrances to the existing exterior stucco walls. Work also includes removal of existing interior walls and the renovation of existing finishes to modern standards.
